minDicePoolFloorEnabled.name: Minimum Dice Pool of 3
minDicePoolFloorEnabled.hint: Kickstarter-only house rule, not in the QSR v0.4 rulebook: floors each player's initiative dice pool at 3, even at 0-1 knights remaining. Off by default.

promptFirstOrSecond.name: Prompt: First or Second
promptFirstOrSecond.hint: Ask the initiative winner whether to go first or second (does not apply when a player is forced first with no choice). On by default. Off: the round always defaults to "first".

promptAttackTarget.name: Prompt: Attack Target
promptAttackTarget.hint: Ask which touching enemy to attack when 2 or more are in base contact. On by default. Off: the round always defaults to the first enemy found in base contact.

round.title: GREATHELM
round.gmOnly: Only the GM can run a GREATHELM round.
round.noApi: BattleFrame's dice and measurement services are unavailable, so a round cannot be run.
round.noCombat: Start a combat encounter before running a GREATHELM round.

firstOrSecond.title: Go first or second?
firstOrSecond.body: You won initiative. Go first or second?

attackTarget.title: Which enemy?
attackTarget.body: Multiple enemies are in base contact. Which one is this attack against?

poolPanel.title: Dice Pool
poolPanel.readOnlyNotice: Read-only: only the GM can spend dice from this panel.
poolPanel.reloadWarning: Reloading this panel loses a half-played round -- the session lives only in memory.
poolPanel.noSelection: Select a die to see which knights may spend it.

reasons.knightRemoved: This knight has been removed from play.
reasons.noEnemyInContact: No enemy is close enough for this knight to activate with this die.

poolPanel.clashHint: Needs an enemy in base contact.
poolPanel.moveHint: Any of your knights still in play may spend this.

actionHint.sprint: Move up to {move}". Gains {momentum} momentum. No clash test — always succeeds.
actionHint.encircle: Move up to {move}". Gains {momentum} momentum. No clash test — always succeeds.
actionHint.bash: Clash test. On a win, shove the defender {move}" away. Deals no damage.
actionHint.shift: Move up to {move}". No momentum, no clash test — always succeeds.
actionHint.light: Clash test. On a win, deals {damage} damage.
actionHint.heavy: Clash test. On a win, deals {damage} damage.

victory.winner: {player} wins — only their knights remain in the play area.
victory.continue: Round {round} over. Both sides still have knights: starting a new round.
victory.mutualElimination: No knights remain on either side. The quickstart rules do not cover a mutual wipe-out (they say "only one player has knights remaining"), so GREATHELM does not define a winner here. Agree the result between you.
